procedure: Built firmware revision 351d693 with local ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Flashed the firmware to the attached ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 on /dev/cu.usbmodem101.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem101 idf-smoke-capabilities from NostrSeal/esp32.
Verified static fixture requests, dynamic request-id variants, invalid metadata requests, and 18 serial-wrapped invalid signing-request vectors loaded from NostrSeal/specs revision c09474e.
Verified that the shared request-unknown-top-level-field vector, a get_public_key request with an unexpected top-level field, returns unsupported_request instead of a public-key response.
expected_result: The device returns valid responses for capability and development public-key requests, refuses sign_event with signing_disabled, and rejects invalid metadata plus every shared invalid signing-request vector with deterministic unsupported_request error frames.
observed_result: The device returned 26 protocol frames: six valid static/dynamic response frames and 20 unsupported_request error frames. The error frames covered two invalid metadata vectors and 18 serial-wrapped invalid signing-request vectors, including the unknown top-level field request. No parser exception, malformed_frame response, public-key response to the invalid request, or real signing output was observed.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no trusted display, GPIO, camera, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
get_public_key uses the deterministic development fixture key, not production key custody.

sign_event is expected to remain disabled until the parser limits, trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
